description: Neuroscience is an interdisciplinary field that explores the nervous system from molecules and
cells to circuits, behavior, and social interaction. Drawing on biology, psychology, chemistry,
physics, computer science, engineering, mathematics, and philosophy, this course introduces
foundational concepts, methods, and tools used to study the brain. Students examine major open
questions, explore how neuroscience benefits society, and learn how the components of the
neuroscience major integrate into a coherent program of study. Offered annually during fall and
spring semester. Open only to first year students.
